scope: 30 Prayer records marked NOT_REVIEWED in v3 source certification inventory
source_review_policy: A visible original/secondary passage is only an anchor observation. Never claim fully certified EN/FR/LA prayer text or permit automated text replacement from scraped witnesses.

items.title: Morning Offering
items.evidence_locator: USCCB prayer heading and Gautrelet attribution
items.evidence_note: Published English prayer is present; app English begins with the same wording. French and Latin remain uncollated.

items.title: My Lord and My God
items.evidence_locator: USCCB John 20 reference
items.evidence_note: Bible URL could not be independently fetched; do not infer verbatim John 20:28 text or edition alignment from the link alone.

items.title: Confiteor

items.title: Consecration to Immaculate Heart
items.evidence_locator: Fatima Center Act of Consecration
items.evidence_note: English composition is present; secondary devotional witness, not a multilingual approved liturgical form.

items.title: O Salutaris Hostia

items.title: Come, Holy Spirit
items.evidence_locator: USCCB Prayer to the Holy Spirit
items.evidence_note: USCCB has invocation and collect, but app adds ℣/℟ labels and uses historical English form.

items.title: Prayer to St. Michael

items.title: Memorare to St. Joseph
items.evidence_locator: Diocese of Sacramento, Memorare to St Joseph
items.evidence_note: English prayer present, but app says 'my sweet protector' where site says 'my great protector'. Do not mark verbatim.

items.title: Consecration to Christ the King
items.evidence_locator: Itheca: Oratio ad Iesum Christum Regem
items.evidence_note: Matching Latin universal-King prayer appears after other Christ prayers; page is Latin, not evidence of app English/French translation.

items.title: Prayer for the Pope
items.evidence_locator: Vatican News, Prayer for the Pope
items.evidence_note: Source has current pope named and a shorter sequence; app contains generic N. plus Tu es Petrus and historical wording. Related only, not exact transcription.

items.evidence_locator: Preces Latinae, Si quaeris miracula
items.evidence_note: Full Latin with English translation of responsory is present; edition/attribution and translation comparison remain.

items.evidence_note: Apostolic Penitentiary source gives the Latin Act of Reparation; EN/FR renderings remain uncollated.

items.evidence_locator: USCCB Sacred Heart novena, Day 7
items.evidence_note: Source quotes 'Sacred Heart of Jesus, I place all my trust in you' but app has 'Most Sacred Heart of Jesus'; contextual witness rather than same exact wording.

items.title: De Profundis — Psalm 129
items.evidence_locator: With God Evening Prayers, De Profundis for the Faithful Departed
items.evidence_note: Traditional Psalm 129 appears; app and historical English vary in particulars, with 129/130 numbering distinction.

items.title: Litany of Saint Joseph
items.evidence_locator: USCCB Litany of Saint Joseph 2021 expanded form

items.evidence_note: Historic English prayer is appended to encyclical; compare app FR/LA and punctuation separately.

items.title: Veni Sancte Spiritus · Pentecost Sequence
items.evidence_locator: Raccolta (1857), Veni Sancte Spiritus sequence and Caswall translation
items.evidence_note: Latin sequence and historical Caswall English present; original Wikisource page title has transcription typo 'piritus'. French remains uncollated.

items.title: Prayer for All the Faithful Departed
items.evidence_locator: Catholic Prayer Book, Prayers for the Dead, collect
items.evidence_note: Traditional collect appears but app English changes wording ('grant' rather than 'give'); do not label verbatim.

items.title: Eternal Rest · for one deceased person
items.evidence_locator: Catholic Truth Society Prayers for the Dead
items.evidence_note: Singular prayer appears with selectable him/her inflections; app uses combined 'him or her' as editorial rendering.

items.title: Sub Tuum Praesidium
items.evidence_locator: 2018 Holy See Press Office communiqué: Sub tuum praesidium
items.evidence_note: Original Latin invocation and English translation on page; app pronouns/wording are a historical-style alternative.

items.title: Adoremus in aeternum · Psalm 116/117
items.evidence_locator: Lasance Blessed Sacrament Book root front matter
items.evidence_note: Book root has Adoremus title/short invocation, not the full Psalm 116/117 sequence shown in app; requires exact source subsection.

items.title: Litany of Loreto · 1962-era form
items.evidence_locator: Prayer-book for Religious, Book 2: Litany of Blessed Virgin
items.evidence_note: Historical form is a comparator and predates later Marian invocations; this is not an exact 1962-edition witness.

items.title: Litany of Loreto · current invocations
items.evidence_locator: Holy See current Litany of Loreto
items.evidence_note: Current form contains Mother of Mercy, Mother of Hope and Solace of Migrants; avoid relabelling as 1962.

release_gates: Source target must contain the prayer or an explicitly qualified related witness.
Same prayer version and full liturgical or devotional sequence must be compared, including locale and current/traditional distinctions.
EN/FR/LA requires independent line-level witness/translation verification, with original-source links.
No automatic text replacement or new duplicate controls in live Prayer reader.
